kicker: Ego2Act and EgoTools, first-person video benchmarks

scenes.headline: How you grade a video model that does chores
scenes.sub: Two first-person benchmarks that score object state, not pretty frames.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Paneer! Two new first-person video benchmarks, and how they grade a task step by step.

scenes.text: Give a video generator a start frame and a goal, then grade each required step, task and physics, with gates that stop at the first failure.
scenes.say: Give a generator a start frame and a goal, then grade every required step.

scenes.title: From a goal to a score

steps.say: A real photo, plus a goal: milk in the cup. No step list.
The generator must plan the steps itself and render the rollout.
The judge splits the goal into subgoals: turn the cup upright, open the carton, pour.
Each subgoal climbs task gates, then physics gates. The first failure ends the climb.

parts.note: task: mean gates passed, over every subgoal
parts.say: T counts the task gates each subgoal passed.

parts.note: physics: averaged over attempted subgoals only
parts.say: P is physics, averaged only over steps the model attempted.

parts.note: a zero on either axis zeroes the video
parts.say: A zero on either axis zeroes the video.

left.title: Wan 2.7, seed 101
left.say: One rollout tries every step but never turns the cup over. Physics fails. Zero.

right.title: MiniMax H3, seed 101
right.say: Another only flips the cup and stops. One clean step: fifty-seven point seven.

steps.say: Here is that skipped step: the mug starts upside down.
So the milk lands on its base. The model never tracked the mug's state.

scenes.title: Human-rated Final score
scenes.say: Human raters put the best generator at sixty-four out of a hundred. The released ratings reproduce this.

scenes.label: Per-video Pearson correlation, judge versus human consensus
scenes.say: The judge's point six nine is a per-video correlation. Humans against each other reach point seven six.

scenes.title: The understanding side: four question tracks
scenes.say: The second benchmark flips it: real tool-use footage, and eight-choice questions.

items.say: Which tool, and what changed? Even the best model is weakest here.

scenes.text: Generators and judges fail at the same thing: carrying object state through a chain of hand actions.
scenes.say: Generators and judges fail at the same thing: carrying object state through hand actions.

recap: Gates per subgoal, stop at first failure
scenes.say: Gates per subgoal. Physics counts attempted steps only. The judge ranks well, but scores high.
